suggestion.en:
Left behind by Levia, Refin narrowed his already
thin eyes and nodded in agreement.
I found myself recalling the old Levia...
Over a decade ago, I received a mansion in
Lewinia's royal capital. As ally to Water Maiden,
ready to lend strength if necessary, I had just
a brief peace. Then Levia and Refin appeared.
Both were born to knightly families. Refin admired
my strength. Levia, in a white dress with a
fleeting smile and a white flower, always by my
side, as if to soothe my heart, smiled...
Several years passed. Through my pact
with the Water Maiden, I went to many battles,
and returned from deadly battles. What greeted me
was Levia in armor, with sword and resolute eyes.

suggestion.en: Left behind by Levia, Refin squinted his already narrow eyes even further and nodded in agreement. I suddenly found myself remembering the Levia of old... Over ten years ago, when I was granted a mansion in the royal capital of Lewinia as an ally to lend strength to the Water Maiden whenever needed, just after I had obtained a brief respite from my wandering life, that was when Levia and Refin appeared before me. Both of them were born into knightly families. Refin admired my strength. Levia, dressed in a white dress, with a fragile smile and white flowers in hand, always smiled beside me as if to soothe my heart, weary from a life of flight... Then, as the years passed, I went to many wars under the covenant with the Water Maiden, and when I returned from the brink of death, the one who greeted me was the Levia of today. She wore armor instead of a dress, carried a sword instead of flowers, and in her eyes she bore the light of determination instead of a smile.

    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01789-01792",

      "en": "When I urged her to continue, Levia's face reddened, but not quite in anger. Something felt strange..."

    {

      "jp": "そうだ……",

    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01828-01830",
      "page_role": "narration",

      "en": "That's the report. Just be careful\nyou don't get attacked yourself."

    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01839-01841",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "残りの言葉を急いで言い放ったレヴィアは、\n赤くした顔を隠すようにそそくさと部屋から\n出ていってしまった。",
      "en": "Levia rattled off the rest of her report,\nthen scurried out of the room, trying to hide\nher flushed face."

    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01843-01844",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "こういう話しに関しては相変わらず初だな……",
      "en": "She's still so naive about that kind of talk..."

      "block_id": "s1:block:01850-01851",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Refin",
      "jp": "そうですね",
      "en": "Indeed."

suggestion.en: Left behind by Levia, Refin narrows her already slender eyes in agreement. I suddenly remember the Levia of the past... Over ten years ago, when I was granted a mansion in the royal capital of Lewinia and had just gained a fleeting peace as an ally to the Water Maiden, that was when Levia and Refin appeared before me. Both born to knightly families, Refin admired my strength, while Levia, clad in a white dress with a fleeting smile and white flowers in hand, always stayed by my side, smiling as if to soothe my heart weary from a life on the run. Years passed, and after many battles under my pact with the Water Maiden, when I returned from countless brushes with death, it was Levia who greeted me: no longer in a dress but in armor, sword in place of flowers, and in her eyes a light of resolve instead of her former smile.
